summary: One message was sent in this chat all week, and it was not from Sarah. Michelle Queue posted the templated weekly leak-removal breakdown on Aug 17 — 'Hey babes! Here’s your weekly update on the leak removal breakdown for the past 7 days 🫶🏼' — and that is the entire week. Sarah sent zero messages. I can’t see it in there'), which makes 10 consecutive days of silence — the longest gap in the 11 months since this chat opened on 2025-09-16, longer than any of her travel weeks. She normally sends 17-31 messages a week; she sent 19 the week ending Aug 7 and 17 the week ending Aug 14. Nothing has moved on any of the four things she was waiting for. Her main Instagram @sarah.h44 (~530k) has been suspended since Aug 9 and Vivek's last word on it was 'okay no problem thanks' on Aug 9 — 12 days with no status update on the single thing she has told us repeatedly matters most to her. The 2 other down accounts are 15 days old and untouched. Her first-ever earnings complaint ('why have I gone down to 3k days😭') is 13 days old with no plan. The only ALTR-side movement was Ronnie Chat re-sending the fixed OFTV file on Aug 14 at 16:38 ('let me know if you can view it now ^^') — 82 hours after she asked where it was, and she never replied to confirm. Worst of all, Stephski told her on Aug 14 'Will reach out to you tomorrow!' about the Aug 1-14 invoice, and then never did. As of Aug 21 that invoice is six days late and unissued — the first missed invoice cycle in 11 months and roughly 23 consecutive on-time cycles. Nobody at ALTR chased her, checked on her, or asked why the most talkative client on the roster went quiet.

Sarah has not sent a message in 10 days — her longest silence ever, and it started immediately after a week in which her main IG was lost for the third time, her first revenue complaint got a question instead of an answer, and her OFTV fix could not be found. In the seven days that followed, ALTR sent exactly one message: an automated-format leak-removal post. Vivek has said nothing about @sarah.h44 for 12 days. Derrek's promised Phone Farm updates are 20 days overdue. And ALTR failed to invoice her at all on Aug 15 after explicitly promising to, breaking a cadence that had not slipped once since October 2025. Every previous long silence from Sarah (Mar 19-28, Jun 9-18) happened with nothing open and ended with her opening a new opportunity unprompted; this one is sitting on top of four unresolved failures and a broken billing promise. Treat as active churn risk, not a lull.
